question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing ‘4’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1589f9e27a86399df1f5e4e2093967155bbeed51687ad856ce8b1c99b9002c2b.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 3 is common on both the dice I and III, it is clear that 1, 5, 2, and 4 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 6 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43cf767ad893d90ab2d59d847e9fcde24b85e20717e792b382201d86071f9b6d.png] 

Opposite pairs:

5 → 2

1 → 4

3 → 6

So, the opposite side of "4" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
